title: Date Night
description: As Grandma tells Kid-2 that she and Pa have date night tonight, he asks if he can come along and offers to turn his head if they want to hold hands or kiss.
alt: In a cozy living room, Grandma says that she and Pa have date night tonight. Wearing a generic white football jersey with navy stripes, Kid-2 asks if he can come and says he can turn his head if they want to hold hands or kiss. Pa smiles beside Grandma.
